requirements.statement: Every criterion the Judge rules not met carries exactly one kind (build-defect, evidence-gap or not-checkable-here); recorded in verification-state.json and shown in verification-report.md. Must pass.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O1 (copied from investigation Objectives O1)

requirements.statement: Only build-defect criteria are handed to the Debug stage; an iteration with no build defect dispatches no Debug agent. Must pass.

An evidence-gap criterion gets exactly one re-capture per run; if still an evidence gap it is settled as an evidence gap with its reason and reported as a definition problem; afterwards it counts toward neither the open nor closed side of the stalled and cap rules. Must pass.

A not-checkable-here result is settled once with its reason; a later invocation (resume or /verify-build fix round) does not re-open it unless verification.md has changed since it was recorded, in which case it re-opens. Must pass.

A parts-only design board's structure row and a design-structure row whose environment is production/minified are classified at preflight, enter the run already settled not-checkable-here, and are never handed to Exercise. Not marked must pass.
The setup check tolerates a dev server cold start: a warm-up request and a generous first-response timeout before a target's reach is recorded as failed. Not marked must pass.

/verify-build fix rounds and /refine-verification read the recorded kind instead of re-deriving buildability from the cause; they fall back to the cause only for a state file written before this change. Not marked must pass.

One headless fixture run of /verify-build (fixtures environment) shows all three kinds in its report; the fixture is seeded with one defect, one missing capture and one host-only criterion. Not marked must pass.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives O8 (investigation Objectives O8, acceptance)

requirements.statement: Tests pass; unit coverage at least 60% and integration coverage at least 50% where integration tests apply. Not marked must pass.

Every new input is validated where it enters (the two new workflow arguments, the new decideNext input, the two new CLI subcommands); a malformed value fails loudly and is never defaulted leniently. Not marked must pass.
Documentation is updated: sibling TRDs whose decisions change carry an inline amendment marker pointing here, and the Judge's contract states the kind vocabulary. Not marked must pass.

open_questions: No PRD exists under docs/PRD for this feature. Requirements O1-O12 come from the TRD's Objectives table, which copies the investigation (docs/plan/triage-unmet-results-by-kind.investigation.md). O9-O12 are labelled as constitution-derived or domain-derived in the TRD.

TRD OQ-1 (Open Questions, TRD): Should a run whose only open criteria are settled evidence gaps end satisfied? Assumed: yes, through the existing satisfied branch, still blocked by coverage floor and must-pass (D7); the report's new section names each as a definition problem. If wrong: add a distinct outcome, touching every outcome reader.

TRD OQ-2: Is never-exercised an evidence gap? Assumed: yes (D2), following investigation OQ-2; it re-captures once instead of reaching Debug. If wrong: map it back to build-defect in KIND_BY_CAUSE (one table cell plus its pin).

TRD OQ-3: Should not-checkable-here from a temporarily unusable environment persist until verification.md changes (TR1)? Assumed: yes, O4 as written, no extra re-open trigger. If wrong: also re-open when the criterion's environment result changes, recording the environment name per entry.

TRD OQ-4: An evidence gap first seen on the cap iteration has no iteration left for its re-capture. Should it count as open at the cap? Assumed: yes; not settled, so the run ends stuck as today. If wrong: settle at the cap without a re-capture, which needs a rule for re-capture impossible.

TRD OQ-5: Are a 60-second first-response timeout and about 90 seconds of retries generous enough? Assumed: yes (investigation D13 values; design parameters, not acceptance thresholds). If wrong: raise the constants in buildSetupPrompt.
TRD OQ-6: Which verification.md copy is digested? Assumed: the copy owner-rules.js path verification.md prints, which section 8.1a already reads (D9). If wrong: switch the CLI argument in 8.1a.
TRD OQ-7: Should O8's task be [LIVE], departing from the investigation? Assumed: yes (D19); [LIVE] is not deferred. If wrong: drop the marker; task text and acceptance unchanged.
TRD OQ-8: Should a settled evidence gap appear under ## Not Met as well as the new section? Assumed: no, only the new section (D16). If wrong: list it in both, a renderer-only change.

Investigation OQ-1: Should a run whose only open criteria are settled evidence gaps end satisfied? Assumed: yes, through the existing satisfied branch, still blocked by coverage floor and must-pass; the report's new section names each as a definition problem.
Investigation OQ-2: Is never-exercised an evidence gap? Assumed: yes (no capture reached the Judge); it now re-captures once instead of reaching Debug.
